content:
Hi all,

I'm starting some Lean work on the Malliavin calculus, aiming to prove the closability of the Malliavin derivative (to begin). I've made a start (https://github.com/Big-Tiki-Torch/LeanMalliavinCalculus) with just definitions so far (of isonormal Gaussian processes and smooth cylindrical functionals).

My plan is to state the derivative as a LinearPMap from Ω →₂[P] ℝ to Ω →₂[P] H and prove IsClosable so the APIs for closure, HasCore, and the adjoint come automatically.

Checking in to see if there's existing work on this area and if this plan looks sensible?

Thanks!
